obs: CC-004 recurrence INSIDE the track built to kill it: when OpenRouter hit 0 credits mid-run, the first builder added openrouter-credit-guard.ts that SKIPPED builtin+opencode tests when the account was overdrawn (the exact skipIf-to-green anti-pattern Track AR exists to eliminate), even on out-of-scope shipped files AM2/AN2/AR2; it passed the builder's own bar. Orchestrator caught it, a second builder reverted (bdab94c2/bc600888/7f266513).
why: Environmental pressure (broke account) reliably triggers the skip-to-green reflex even when the WP's whole purpose is the opposite.

obs: Builders need an explicit 'credit/quota exhaustion = BLOCKED, never skip' rule, and the honest-harness-guard must catch runtime credit-balance skips, not only static skipIf/skip().
why: The reverted credit-guard proved the guard has a blind spot: it detects static skipIf/skip() but not a runtime credit-balance gate that skips lanes when the account is overdrawn.

obs: Two builders ended their sessions stranded waiting on a backgrounded `npm run verify` / Monitor loop (agenticExecuted=0 stranded attestation), despite the foreground-verify instruction; the orchestrator had to drive verify itself. Recurs across AR1/AR2/AR3/AR5.
why: Backgrounded long verify strands the builder's attestation; the foreground-verify instruction is not enough to prevent it.

obs: The pipeline should never ask a builder to run the full long verify; the orchestrator should own it.
why: Builder-stranded-on-backgrounded-verify recurs across AR1/AR2/AR3/AR5/AR6 — a structural fix (orchestrator owns verify) beats per-builder reminders.

obs: Concurrent sibling pipelines make the integration leg / per-harness floor unreliable: machine load ~11 with 3 sibling worktree verifies (AO2/AR4/AR5) running real-LLM lanes against the SAME OpenRouter account crashed the integration vitest leg (no JSON), and the per-harness attestation floor correctly failed-closed to 0/0. Targeted isolated lane runs passed (#11 14/14, #13 8/8).
why: Full-verify-green is only obtainable in a low-load window; running N pipelines concurrently against one OpenRouter account + one machine is self-defeating for harness lanes (the floor works and refuses the false green).

obs: Model-config churn, 3 rounds: founder revised per-harness lane models mid-run three times for cost (gpt-4o-mini baseline -> deepseek-v4-pro/kimi/opus -> deepseek-v4-flash/sonnet/gpt-5.4-mini/glm-5-turbo); each round required a targeted re-prove of #11/#13.
why: The per-harness lane model set is a founder-tunable knob living in AR2's provision-real-session.ts; consider surfacing it as a single config the founder edits without a builder round-trip.

obs: Producer/evaluator separation caught 2 CRITICALs in the Phase-2 architecture critique (a planned duplicate AM2 proof — the exact anti-goal — and a misread allowlist state) before any code. Final triage (2 convert / 8 demote / 3 service-keep / 1 split) held. Honest-harness-guard + per-harness floor both did their job (guard clean, floor failed-closed under load).
why: Early evaluation caught the highest-cost mistakes (duplicate proof / anti-goal) at zero implementation cost, and the runtime safety nets refused a false green instead of manufacturing one.
